title: Mezan Law Firm
subtitle: Mohamed Eid Abo Lafi | Comprehensive Legal Support for Egyptians & Foreigners
about_desc: Mezan Law Firm, led by Mr. Mohamed Eid Abo Lafi, a registered attorney with the Egyptian Bar Association, provides robust legal solutions and litigation services for Egyptian citizens, alongside specialized, high-tier expertise in securing all legal, corporate, and property transactions for foreigners in Egypt.
service1_desc: Handling all legal marriage procedures for foreigners at the Egyptian Ministry of Justice, certified translations, and fast issuance of official digitized certificates with absolute confidentiality.
service2_desc: Incorporation of all company types for Egyptian and foreign investors, drafting international/domestic commercial contracts, and expert representation before GAFI.
service3_desc: Title deed verification, due diligence, and official registration at the Real Estate Registry (Shahr Akary) for locals and foreigners to fully secure your property investments.
service4_title: ⚖️ Litigation & Legal Representation for Egyptians & Foreigners
service4_desc: Expert defense in criminal and civil law, and comprehensive handling of family and alimony cases before all tiers of Egyptian courts for individuals of all nationalities.
